title: Square hay before Operators
purpose: Traverse a square with nested loops before arithmetic and comparisons are unlocked.
start: A square Grassland field growing grass.

title: Square bushes before Operators
purpose: Grow bushes across a square without Operators, explicit variable assignments or sensors.
start: A square field with grass or bushes.

title: Hay before Senses
purpose: Collect hay on a square without sensors or custom functions.
start: A square Grassland field growing grass.

title: Bushes before Senses
purpose: Farm wood across a square with no sensors.
start: A square field with grass or bushes.

title: One-time soil preparation
purpose: Till every tile once before sensor-free carrot seeding.
start: Every tile must be Grassland; run once only.

title: Carrots before Senses
purpose: Seed empty soil, then harvest and replant mature carrots; stop on failed planting.
start: Empty Soil on the entire square; sufficient hay and wood. Restarting on young carrots is unsupported.

title: Hay with ground repair
purpose: Restore Grassland, remove conflicting crops and collect mature grass.
start: An ordinary square field; other crops may be removed.

title: Carrots with sensors
purpose: Maintain carrots while preserving young plants and stopping on failed planting.
start: An ordinary square field; enough hay and wood for carrots.

title: Separated trees and hay
purpose: Grow nonadjacent trees with grass on the other tiles, including wrap-safe odd squares.
start: An ordinary square of at least 2x2; conflicting crops may be removed.

title: Separated trees and bushes
purpose: Use separated trees for wood and bushes on the remaining tiles.
start: An ordinary square field; conflicting crops may be removed. A 1x1 field grows a bush.

title: Pumpkins without Lists
purpose: Repair dead pumpkins with full-field passes and harvest only when the whole square is ready.
start: An ordinary square field and a reserve of carrots.

title: Sunflowers without Lists
purpose: Harvest petal counts from 15 down to 7, keeping nine flowers when the field can hold ten.
start: An ordinary square field and enough carrots to plant sunflowers.

title: Fresh-maze wall follower
purpose: Create and solve fresh mazes without Lists, mapping or treasure relocation.
start: An ordinary field or a treasure tile, outside any existing hedge maze; sufficient Weird Substance.

title: Cactus without Lists
purpose: Bubble-sort rows and columns, then harvest the mature field.
start: An ordinary square field and enough pumpkins to plant cacti.
